desc: Read input: N, X, arrays A, B, P, Q.
Build reverse red graph: rev_red = [[] for _ in range(N+1)], for i in 0..N-1: rev_red[P[i]].append(i+1)
Build reverse blue graph: rev_blue = [[] for _ in range(N+1)], for i in 0..N-1: rev_blue[Q[i]].append(i+1)
BFS from X in rev_red to get R_set (set of nodes that can reach X in red graph).
BFS from X in rev_blue to get B_set.
For each i in 1..N: if A[i-1]==1 and i not in R_set, print -1 and exit.
For each i in 1..N: if B[i-1]==1 and i not in B_set, print -1 and exit.
For each i in 1..N: if A[i-1]==1, traverse red path from i to X, adding each node (except X) to S, breaking if node already in S.
For each i in 1..N: if B[i-1]==1, traverse blue path from i to X, adding each node (except X) to S, breaking if node already in S.
